Telangana TOSS SSC and Intermediate Supplementary Results Declared

The Telangana TOSS SSC and Intermediate Supplementary Results for 2026 have been declared. Girls outperformed boys in both the SSC and Intermediate examinations. Direct links to the results and information on recounting dates are available.
